githubDescription:
SakuraCord v0.1.6 adds server joining and onboarding, bot buttons and native forms, a rebuilt slash-command editor, polls, an Unread and Mentions Inbox, and on-device translation. It also adds upload privacy controls, server and folder organization, friend nicknames, in-app bug reports and an app-wide Interface size setting, and improves scrolling, sign-in and media previews.

## Servers and invites

- Added server joining from invite links, codes and interactive invite cards, including supported CAPTCHA challenges, and Leave Server for members who do not own the server.
- Added native server onboarding, Server Guide tasks and resources, and Channels & Roles for choosing which channels and categories appear in your list.
- Added invite creation with expiration, use limits and temporary membership, plus a saved list of invites created in SakuraCord.
- Added drag-and-drop server reordering, moving servers into and out of folders, and folder name and color customization, all synced with Discord.
- Added server tags to the timeline, member list and profiles. Clicking a tag opens the server's profile card, and a new setting hides everyone's tags.

## Bots, commands and reports

- Added buttons and select menus in bot messages, and native modal forms with text fields, select menus, checkboxes, radio buttons and file uploads.
- Rebuilt the slash-command editor with editable argument fields, keyboard navigation, validation, Frequently Used commands synced with Discord, and searchable Apps menus.
- Added slash commands in threads, voice-channel chats and existing forum posts, plus built-in commands including `/nick`.
- Added in-app bug reports and feature suggestions through `/bug`, `/suggest` and the Help menu, with attachments, optional diagnostics, and matching against existing reports.

## Messaging, polls and translation

- Added native polls with answer emojis, configurable durations, multiple-answer voting, live results and voter lists.
- Added optional on-device translation for messages and drafts using Apple's Translation framework, with mentions, links, emoji and code kept intact.
- Added Create Thread to the composer, joined threads in the channel sidebar, and live member lists for full-width threads and forum posts.
- Added pasting of images and files into messages, forum posts and command fields, and converted pasted text longer than 4,000 characters into a `message.txt` attachment.
- Added friend nicknames and Change Nickname for server members, following Discord's permission rules.
- Added native macOS dictionary lookup and sent dates in message timestamps, and improved how spoilers are hidden across messages, previews and notifications.
- Fixed Japanese text input, thread history gaps, webhook identities, and server nickname editing.

## Inbox, DMs and profiles

- Added an Inbox with Unread and Mentions tabs, mention filters, direct navigation to messages, and mark-as-read actions with undo.
- Added pinned DMs and group DMs, unread conversations in the server rail, and avatars and presence in the DM toolbar.
- Made read DMs less prominent than unread ones and dimmed muted conversations while they are not selected.
- Added mobile presence indicators, live status updates in open profiles, and a SakuraCord Sponsor badge for recognized sponsors.

## Attachments, links and privacy

- Added removal of location, camera and other personal metadata from images and videos before upload. It is on by default and leaves your original files unchanged.
- Added optional filename anonymisation, a Select from Photos option in the composer, and local compression for oversized images and videos.
- Added a Features settings page for hidden-channel visibility, individual FakeNitro options, translation, and attachment handling, including when to use Catbox or Litterbox.
- Added video poster frames to the timeline, forum cards, forwarded messages, the media viewer and the composer.
- Added a built-in list of trusted domains with wildcard support, and refreshed expired Discord attachment links before opening them.

## Appearance and reliability

- Added an Interface size setting that scales text, icons and controls throughout SakuraCord, with keyboard shortcuts.
- Added an animation for sent messages in the bubble style and fixed bubble replies, editing, media sizing, reactions and mention readability.
- Improved emoji, sticker and soundboard pickers, and made Frequently Used emoji follow Discord's ordering and sync with other Discord clients.
- Reduced scrolling stalls when loading message history and showing long messages and media.
- Fixed sign-in failures on large accounts and the main window closing after selecting an account.
- Kept SakuraCord and active calls running after the last window closes.
- Added Homebrew installation for regular releases on Apple Silicon with `brew install --cask SakuraCordApp/tap/sakuracord`.

**Full Changelog:** [v0.1.5...v0.1.6](https://github.com/SakuraCordApp/SakuraCord/compare/v0.1.5...v0.1.6)
discordAnnouncement:
**Server joining, bot interactions, polls, and translation 🌸**

**Highlights**
- Join servers from invites, complete onboarding, and arrange servers in custom folders synced with Discord.
- Use bot buttons, select menus, and native forms, with a rebuilt slash-command editor that also works in threads.
- Create polls, catch up in the Unread and Mentions Inbox, pin DMs, and give friends nicknames.
- Translate messages and drafts on-device, and scale the whole app with the new Interface size setting.
- Uploads remove personal metadata by default, with filename anonymisation, a Photos picker, and compression.
- Report bugs from inside SakuraCord, with smoother scrolling and more reliable sign-in.
